about.paragraph1: I'm Tetiana, a Java developer who enjoys building thoughtful backend systems and learning every day.
about.paragraph2: I love books, structured notes, and tools like Notion that help turn ideas into a calmer rhythm.
about.paragraph3: This website is my small digital studio where I share what I'm building, learning, and discovering along the way.
about.catNote: My cat Varya keeps the studio light and playful, a small reminder to pause and enjoy quiet moments between tasks.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.description: Here you'll find answers to common questions about downloads, Notion templates, and how everything works.
faq.imageCaption: Varya is supervising the support department.
faq.stillQuestionDescription: Send me a message and I'll be happy to help.

items.title: What are these products?
items.content: They are digital templates, planners, and simple systems designed to help you organize ideas, routines, and projects with more clarity.

items.title: How do I receive the product?
items.content: After checkout, you'll receive an email with a download link. The download is also available on the success page right after purchase.

items.title: Do I need Notion to use the templates?
items.content: Notion templates require a free Notion account. If a product is a PDF or printable, you can use it without Notion.

items.title: Can I share the template with others?
items.content: Please keep downloads for personal use only. If someone you know wants a copy, sharing the product link is the best way to support the work.

items.title: I didn't receive the email
items.content: Check your Spam or Promotions folder and confirm the email was entered correctly. If it still doesn't arrive, send me a message and I'll help right away.

items.title: Are paid products coming?
items.content: Yes. I'm preparing a small collection of paid templates and guides. Updates will appear on the shop page as they are ready.

items.title: Can I request a feature or template?
items.content: Absolutely. Send me a short message with what you need and how you plan to use it. I read every note.

sections.title: Information I collect
paragraphs: When you send a message through the contact form, I collect the information you provide, such as your email address and message content.
The website may also collect basic usage information, such as page visits or device data, through cookies or analytics tools.

sections.title: How your information is used
paragraphs: Your information is used to respond to your messages, provide support, and improve the website experience.
I do not sell or rent personal information.

sections.title: Email communications
paragraphs: If you contact me, I reply to the email address you provide. You only receive emails related to your request unless you opted into updates.
You can request removal from communications at any time.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: Cookies may be used to keep the website running smoothly and to understand how visitors use the site.
You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work as intended.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: I may use trusted third-party services for hosting, email delivery, or analytics. These services receive only the information needed to perform their functions.

sections.title: Data protection
paragraphs: Reasonable safeguards are used to protect your information, but no online system can guarantee complete security.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time.
